notes.title: Love and Hatred Officially Released!
notes.content: [p]Happy to announce that Love and Hatred is now officially released! 15% launch discount for the first two weeks. [/p][p]I hope you all enjoy this unique AVN story I created. It has heavy emphasis on the choices you make and will determine what content you get to see. Whether that be lewd scenes, alternative scenarios or drastically changing the fate of different characters. You won’t be able to see everything in one playthrough, so replaying is highly encouraged![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45526935/b1c607ab043debec42657ba9147077fde3f21bc6.png"][/img]Take care,[/p][p]LewdPalace[/p]
